title: Sources: Singapore-based DayOne pauses its US IPO plans to raise up to $5B as soon as Q4 amid market volatility and valuation concerns around AI infrastructure (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Singapore-based DayOne pauses its US IPO plans to raise up to $5B as soon as Q4 amid market volatility and valuation concerns around AI infrastructure — DayOne Data Centers Ltd. has put plans for its multibillion-dollar US initial public offering on hold, people familiar with the matter said …
